stepSays.show: Shows an entry or a statement ("of"), or a file ("media"); "title" — the screen heading.
stepSays.question: Asks a question ("of": a question or a card key); exits "right" and "wrong".
stepSays.choice: Offers a choice: "options" [{"label", "condition"?}]; exit "o0", "o1", … for each option.
stepSays.condition: Checks a condition ("condition" — one logic); exits "yes" and "no". Whoever knows the entry goes on: {"type": "knowness", "of": "@wpis", "op": "ge", "than": 1} (the old step “Basics first”, "prerequisite", is read as such a condition: "known" → "yes", "explain" → "no").
stepSays.chapters: Chapters ("chapters": [{"title"}]); exit "c0", "c1", … — the start of a chapter; "done" when all are finished.
stepSays.chapterEnd: End of chapter — goes back to the chapter choice.
stepSays.subflow: Enters another flow ("flow"); after it exit "next".
stepSays.each: For each entry of a collection ("collection") or kind ("kind") — another flow ("flow") with {item}; then "next".
stepSays.expand: Explains the concept "of" in place when it is not known yet; then "next".
stepSays.line: A character ("character") says a sentence ("of": a statement — an entry with a “Block content” field); "mood" — the mood; "next".
stepSays.handoff: Hands over to another flow ("flow") — that one starts from the beginning.
stepSays.detour: Offers a detour into another story ("flow", "label" — “Want to know more: …”): “Enter” plays it and comes back through exit "done", “Continue without it” goes through exit "skip"; "optional": false — only “Enter”.
stepSays.review: A review of the story in one step: asks once more the questions of this story ("of": "story" — or @przebieg) that the learner doesn't know yet — each once per round; when they know at least "threshold" (e.g. 0.9) of them, exit "passed", otherwise "notyet". Saves the value "value" (by default <story name>.przeglad: 1 passed, 0 not); without "goals" the flow gets the goal “Review passed” ("goal" — its name) and “Repeat the review” goes back to this step.
stepSays.scene: A presentation scene ("page" — the page address, "scene" — the scene key, "title"); exit "next", with a question on the scene "right" and "wrong", buttons "b0", "b1", … ("buttons": [{"exit", "label", "target"}]).
stepSays.return: Returns from an inner flow to the place it entered from.

mountain.segmentMissing: The segment “{ref}” does not exist — the player skips this step.
mountain.segmentUnit: The segment “{name}” has its own “unit” — it would become a separate tile. Inner paths of one hexagon have no unit.
mountain.segmentEnd: The segment “{name}” contains “End” — finish an inner path with “Return”, so it goes back to the shared part of the hexagon.

segmentQuestions.one: The segment “{name}” asks {count} question — it is practice only and does not count for the hexagon; put required questions into the shared checkpoint.
segmentQuestions.other: The segment “{name}” asks {count} questions — they are practice only and do not count for the hexagon; put required questions into the shared checkpoint.

mountain.branchQuestion: The question “{name}” lies on only some paths — it does not count for completing the hexagon; move it to the shared part.
mountain.reviewBranch: This review lies on only some paths — put the review into the shared part after the paths meet.
mountain.reviewEmpty: This review has no required questions (none on every path) — it would pass at once.
mountain.noAssessment: The hexagon has no shared assessment: no question and no review lies on every path.
mountain.tooManyRoutes: More than {count} paths — only the first {count} were checked.
mountain.uncheckable: The question “{name}” names neither a topic (“about”) nor explaining slides (“explain”) — its coverage cannot be checked.
mountain.routeNoEnd: The path “{route}” never reaches an end.
mountain.notCovered: The path “{route}” does not prepare the question “{name}”: it shows neither its topic nor one of its explaining slides.
